A real lazy-load address wins over an inline data src when the payload is not kept

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<p><img src="data:image/png;base64,AAAA" data-src="https://example.com/real.png" alt="icon"></p>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(inline_data_media: 'DropElement'))
puts result.content.inspect
```
